questions.stem: Why do large multicellular organisms need a circulatory system rather than relying on diffusion alone?

options.text: Diffusion is too slow to supply cells deep inside the body
Diffusion only works in water, not in air
Diffusion can only transport oxygen, not nutrients
Diffusion requires too much energy in large organisms

questions.explanation: Diffusion is too slow over the large distances found in multicellular organisms, so a circulatory system is needed to transport substances quickly to all cells.
